title: GPU-NFBench: A Human-Labeled Benchmark and LLM-Assisted Triage System for GPU Numerical Failures
description: GPU-NFBench is a 1,191-row human-labeled benchmark and reproducible artifact packet for classifying GPU numerical failure reports from public GitHub issues. The artifact includes v2 adjudicated labels, deterministic baselines, fine-tuned LLM evaluation outputs, selective triage reports, root-cause evidence files, annotation audit files, and the IEEE-format manuscript.
